WITH group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM Examination
  GROUP BY ID
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    record_count,
    CAST(record_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT SUM(record_count) FROM group_counts) as share
  FROM group_counts
),
avg_share_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM with_shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    record_count,
    share
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_val)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(record_count) as average_record_count,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_val)) as average_excess
FROM above_avg;

assumptions.assumption: "Above it" is interpreted as strictly greater than (>) rather than greater than or equal. Groups with share equal to the average share are excluded.
